data.narrative:
Alice & Bob is a Series B quantum computing company founded by Theau Peronnin and Raphael Lescanne, having raised €100M to date. The quantum computing sector comprises 3 public comps (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

Stage-progression methodology is applicable here, using the €100M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement. This yields an implied valuation of €190M. Peer-median analysis is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within quantum computing—while 8 sector peers exist, none satisfy narrow filtering criteria (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier) needed to establish a reliable median. A broad-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise given the heterogeneity of quantum computing business models and maturity levels.

The analysis supports a valuation range of €162M (low) to €218M (high), with a central estimate of €190M. This range reflects the limitations of a single-method triangulation. Key uncertainties include the absence of near-peer transaction data in quantum computing at this stage, the early-stage nature of revenue validation across the sector, and the wide dispersion in technology approaches and commercialization timelines among existing quantum companies. A future recalibration incorporating additional comparables or milestone-based metrics would strengthen conviction in this valuation band.
